title: D2P Body Measurement Profile
description: Artifact content (artifactType 'd2p:body-measurement-profile'): measurement values of one individual body, an anonymous reference figure or a synthetic figure, each with method, origin and optional uncertainty. A profile may be incomplete; a missing value is a diagnosable gap, not an error of the profile. Values of profiles classified 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' never enter export documents (D2P-SEM-050).
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.3 (design decision ADR-011 sections 2, 4 and 8). Not schema-enforced: subject.kind 'individual' requires dataClassification 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (D2P-SEM-051); definitionIds resolve via definitionRegistries (D2P-REF-008); units match definition dimensions (D2P-SEM-070).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

artifactId.description: ID of the artifact this content belongs to.

revisionId.description: ID of the immutable artifact revision this content is.

subject.description: Whose body the values describe. Never carries a real name.

dataClassification.description: Policy classification of the profile. A profile of an individual MUST be 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (D2P-SEM-051) and MUST agree with the artifact metadata.

definitionRegistries.description: Pinned measurement-definition registries (id and version) against which the definitionIds of this document resolve.

measurements.description: The measurement values of the profile. May be incomplete or empty (e.g. a draft profile). Values use body definitions (kind 'body', D2P-SEM-075); a definitionId appears at most once (D2P-REF-005).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document per digest profile d2p-digest-v1 (excluding contentDigest itself).

measurementSubject.title: Measurement subject
measurementSubject.description: The measured subject, identified at most by a pseudonym.

kind.description: 'individual' (a real person), 'reference-figure' (an anonymous reference body, e.g. a dress form or averaged figure), 'synthetic' (invented test data).

pseudonym.description: Optional pseudonym for display. MUST NOT be a real name or other directly identifying data.
